hero.title: Computer Engineering (UG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A **Bachelor’s in Computer Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** can be a good option for students interested in computer hardware, software, embedded systems, digital electronics, computer architecture and intelligent devices. The course combines engineering principles with computing to prepare students for careers in technology, electronics, telecommunications and computer systems. Students who want to **Study Computer Engineering in Mauritius** can explore the available undergraduate programme and compare its curriculum with their career goals.

overview: One directly relevant option is the BTech Computer Engineering programme at VIT Mauritius, which lists an August 2026 intake and tuition fees of €5,000 per year. Students should confirm the latest intake, degree-awarding arrangements and complete fee schedule before applying.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Computer Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Computer Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Computer Engineering (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
